title: El segundo condicional (If I won…, I would…; If I were you)
short: Para soñar e imaginar: If I had more time, I'd learn to paint. Y para aconsejar: If I were you, I'd rest.

story.title: Vamos a soñar
story.text: Para hablar de cosas ==imaginarias o poco probables== usamos el segundo condicional: if + ==pasado==, y luego ==would== + verbo.

examples.t: If I won the lottery, I'd travel the world.
examples.es: Si me tocara la lotería, daría la vuelta al mundo.

examples.t: If I had more time, I'd learn to paint.
examples.es: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería a pintar.

story.title: Las dos partes
story.text: La parte del if va en ==pasado==; el resultado, con ==would + verbo== (sin to).

story.title: If I were you
story.text: Con be, en la parte del if se usa ==were== con todas las personas: If I ==were==, if she ==were==. «If I were you, I'd…» es la forma estrella de ==dar consejos==.

examples.t: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
examples.es: Yo que tú, iría al médico.

examples.t: If it were cheaper, I'd buy it.
examples.es: Si fuera más barato, lo compraría.

story.title: Si tuviera… haría
story.text: En español: «Si ==tuviera==… ==haría==». En inglés: «If I ==had==… I ==would do==». Nuestro subjuntivo pasa a ==pasado simple== y nuestro condicional, a ==would==.

examples.t: If I had time, I'd go with you.
If she knew, she'd be angry.

story.title: ¿Primero o segundo?
story.text: Si lo ves ==posible y real==: If I ==win==, I=='ll== buy… (primer condicional). Si es ==un sueño o algo difícil==: If I ==won==, I=='d== buy… Lo decides tú.

examples.t: If it rains, I'll stay at home.
examples.es: Si llueve, me quedaré en casa. (puede pasar)

examples.t: If I lived in Auckland, I'd go sailing.
examples.es: Si viviera en Auckland, saldría a navegar. (no vivo allí)

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ If I would have money… ✅ If I ==had== money…
❌ If I had time, I will go. ✅ …I ==would== go.
❌ I would to buy. ✅ I would ==buy==.
❌ If I was you… ✅ If I ==were== you…

story.title: Truco: la contracción I'd
story.text: Al hablar casi siempre se contrae: ==I'd== («aid»), you'd, she'd, we'd. Y recuerda: ==would nunca va detrás de if==.

compare.es: En español la parte del «si» va en imperfecto de subjuntivo y el resultado en condicional: «Si tuviera dinero, viajaría». Para aconsejar decimos «Yo que tú…» o «Yo en tu lugar…».
compare.target: En inglés la parte del if va en pasado simple (If I had money) y el resultado con would + verbo sin to (I would travel / I'd travel). Para aconsejar: If I were you, I'd… Nunca se pone would después de if.

errors.wrong: If I would have more money, I'd travel.
errors.right: If I had more money, I'd travel.
errors.why: Detrás de if nunca va would: usa el pasado simple (had).

errors.wrong: If I was you, I'd call her.
errors.right: If I were you, I'd call her.
errors.why: Was se oye en la conversación, pero para aconsejar lo correcto es were.

errors.wrong: If I had time, I will go.
errors.right: If I had time, I would go.
errors.why: Si el if va en pasado, el resultado lleva would, no will.

errors.wrong: If I won the lottery, I would to buy a house.
errors.right: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
errors.why: Después de would, el verbo va sin to.

errors.wrong: If I knew it, I would told you.
errors.right: If I knew it, I would tell you.
errors.why: Después de would, el verbo en su forma base: tell, no told.

errors.wrong: If I win the lottery, I'd buy a boat.
errors.right: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a boat.
errors.why: No mezcles: con I'd, la parte del if va en pasado (won).

exercises.q: If I ___ the lottery, I'd buy a house by the sea.
exercises.why: En la parte del if, pasado simple: won.

exercises.q: If I had more time, I ___ learn to paint.
exercises.why: If + pasado → resultado con would.

exercises.q: If I ___ you, I'd see a doctor.
exercises.why: Para aconsejar: If I were you.

exercises.q: What ___ you do if you lost your passport abroad?
exercises.why: Situación imaginaria: What would you do if…?

exercises.q: If my son ___ closer, I'd see him every day.
exercises.why: No vive cerca: es imaginario, así que pasado (lived).

exercises.q: I ___ worry if I were you. It's nothing serious.
exercises.why: Consejo en negativa: I wouldn't worry.

exercises.q: If it ___ so expensive, we'd fly to New Zealand.
exercises.why: Es caro de verdad, así que imaginamos lo contrario: if it weren't.

exercises.q: If you could live anywhere, where ___ you live?
exercises.why: Pregunta imaginaria: where would you live?

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ stay at home.
exercises.why: Que llueva mañana es posible y real: primer condicional (if + presente, will).

exercises.q: If I ___ more money, I'd travel around the world.
answer: had
exercises.why: Detrás de if, pasado simple: had. Nunca would have.

exercises.q: If I won the lottery, I ___ stop working.
answer: would
exercises.why: If + pasado (won) → would + verbo.

exercises.q: If we ___ a car, we'd visit all the villages.
answer: had
exercises.why: Have en pasado: had.

exercises.q: My friend would be happier if she ___ less.
answer: worked
exercises.why: La parte del if puede ir al final; sigue en pasado: worked.

exercises.q: If I ___ speak English perfectly, I'd work as a tour guide.
answer: could
exercises.why: El pasado de can es could: if I could…

exercises.q: I'd help you if I ___ the answer.
answer: knew
exercises.why: Know → knew (irregular).

exercises.q: If I were you, I ___ buy that sofa. It's far too big.
answer: wouldn't
would not
exercises.why: Consejo negativo: I wouldn't + verbo.

exercises.q: What would you do if you ___ a famous actor in the street?
answer: met
saw
exercises.why: Meet → met. Parte del if en pasado.

exercises.es: Si me tocara la lotería, me compraría una casa
exercises.answer: If I won the lottery I would buy a house
exercises.why: If + won (pasado), would + buy.

exercises.es: Yo que tú, iría al médico
exercises.answer: If I were you I would go to the doctor
exercises.why: Consejo: If I were you, I would…

exercises.answer: What would you do if you had more time
exercises.why: Pregunta: What would you do + if + pasado.

exercises.es: Si viviera más cerca, te vería más
exercises.answer: If I lived nearer I would see you more
exercises.why: Lived (pasado) en el if; would see en el resultado.

exercises.es: No trabajaría si no tuviera que hacerlo
exercises.answer: I wouldn't work if I didn't have to
exercises.why: Las dos partes pueden ser negativas: wouldn't… didn't have to.

exercises.instr: Cámbiala al segundo condicional (lo ves poco probable)
exercises.q: If I win the lottery, I'll buy a boat.
answer: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a boat.
If I won the lottery, I would buy a boat.
exercises.why: win → won y will → would ('d).

exercises.q: If I were you, I'd tell her.
answer: If I were you, I wouldn't tell her.
If I were you, I would not tell her.
exercises.why: I'd → I wouldn't.

exercises.q: You would move to the coast.
answer: Would you move to the coast?
exercises.why: En la pregunta, would va delante del sujeto.

exercises.instr: Da el mismo consejo empezando por If I were you
exercises.q: You should rest more.
answer: If I were you, I'd rest more.
If I were you, I would rest more.
exercises.why: You should… = If I were you, I'd…

exercises.q: If I have time, I'll call you.
answer: If I had time, I'd call you.
If I had time, I would call you.
exercises.why: have → had y I'll → I'd.

exercises.instr: Une las dos ideas con if (imagina lo contrario)
exercises.q: I don't have a garden. I can't grow tomatoes.
answer: If I had a garden, I could grow tomatoes.
If I had a garden, I would grow tomatoes.
If I had a garden, I'd grow tomatoes.
exercises.why: La realidad es negativa; lo imaginario va en positivo: If I had…, I could / would…

exercises.q: If I was you, I'd take a warm jacket.
exercises.why: Was se oye en la calle, pero en consejos lo correcto es were.

exercises.q: If I had more time, I will learn to swim.
exercises.why: Con if + pasado, el resultado lleva would.

exercises.q: If we lived in Auckland, we would sailed every weekend.
exercises.why: Después de would, el verbo va en su forma base: sail.

exercises.q: If you won the lottery, what would you buyed?
exercises.why: Detrás de would, forma base: buy.

exercises.q: If he were taller, he'll play basketball.
exercises.why: Imaginario: he'd (he would), no he'll.

exercises.q: If I find a wallet in the street, I'd take it to the police.
exercises.why: Con I'd, la parte del if va en pasado: found.

exercises.q: If I ___ a big garden, I'd keep chickens.
answer: had
exercises.why: Have → had.

exercises.q: If I ___ you, I'd say sorry.
answer: were
was
exercises.why: Lo más correcto es were (If I were you); was se oye en la conversación.

exercises.q: If we had a week off, we ___ to the mountains.
answer: would go
'd go
exercises.why: Would + verbo base: would go (we'd go).

exercises.q: If my son ___ in Spain, he'd come for lunch every Sunday.
answer: lived
exercises.why: Live → lived.

exercises.q: If I ___ fly, I'd visit Auckland tomorrow.
answer: could
exercises.why: Can en pasado: could.

exercises.q: Si tuviera dinero, viajaría por el mundo.
answer: If I had money, I would travel the world.
If I had money, I'd travel the world.
If I had money, I would travel around the world.
If I had money, I'd travel around the world.
exercises.why: Tuviera → had; viajaría → would travel.

exercises.q: Yo que tú, no lo compraría.
answer: If I were you, I wouldn't buy it.
If I were you, I would not buy it.
If I was you, I wouldn't buy it.
exercises.why: Yo que tú = If I were you.

exercises.q: What would you do if you won the lottery?
answer: ¿Qué harías si te tocara la lotería?
¿Qué harías si te tocase la lotería?
¿Qué harías si ganaras la lotería?
¿Qué harías si ganases la lotería?
exercises.why: Would you do = harías; if you won = si te tocara.

exercises.q: If I lived in New Zealand, I'd learn Māori.
answer: Si viviera en Nueva Zelanda, aprendería maorí.
Si viviese en Nueva Zelanda, aprendería maorí.
Si viviera en Nueva Zelanda, aprendería el maorí.
exercises.why: Lived = viviera; I'd learn = aprendería.

exercises.context: A tu amiga le duele la espalda desde hace semanas. Le das un consejo.
options: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
If I am you, I see a doctor.
If I would be you, I'd see a doctor.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
exercises.why: Consejo: If I were you, I'd…

exercises.context: Te preguntan qué harías con mucho dinero.
exercises.why: Algo imaginario: I'd (I would) + verbo base.

exercises.context: Tu hijo Hugo duda si aceptar un trabajo en otra ciudad. Tú lo aceptarías.
options: If I were you, I'd take it.
If I were you, I'll take it.
If you were me, I'd take it.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I'd take it.
exercises.why: Te pones en su lugar: If I were you, I'd…

pairs: I'd buy a flat by the sea.
I'd take an umbrella. It's cloudy.
If I had more free time,
exercises.why: Une cada condición con su resultado lógico.
Las contracciones de would.
